subject: Permission to feature HealthSync migration vignette in Engineering Spotlight
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@healthsync.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: feature HealthSync migration vignette in 'Engineering Spotlight'

Hi Elena —

Hope you’re well. We’re putting together a short ’Engineering Spotlight’ vignette highlighting the HealthSync migration you and your team completed with Redwood Dedicated last quarter. It would feature a 250–350 word case blurb, one pull-quote from your engineering lead, and a logo in the customer badge.

Can you confirm if HealthSync is comfortable with us featuring: 
- A short technical blurb (draft attached)
- The HealthSync logo (we’ll follow your brand guide)
- Quote attribution to ‘HealthSync — Engineering’

Attached: draft_vignette_v1.pdf (proposed blurb + sample pull-quote). We can share the final copy for approval before publishing and will include the publication date and distribution channels.

Would you be able to confirm by end of week? If you prefer, we can route a brief permission form through DocuSign.

Thanks so much — appreciate your help.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: draft_vignette_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Elena Park <elena.park@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthSync Marketing <marketing@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: feature HealthSync migration vignette in 'Engineering Spotlight'

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over and for the great write-up. We’re happy to be featured. Quick notes from our side before you publish: 

1) Please use the attached brand guidelines and the high-res logos in the zip for any artwork.
2) One small edit to the quote: change “eliminated nightly outages” to “reduced nightly failovers by 90%” — engineering prefers the more specific metric.
3) Please do not include any customer PII or internal architectural drawings.

I’ve attached our brand guide and logo pack. If you’ll send the final copy and a one-page permission form, I can get the legal/marketing review and sign-off this week.

Best,
Elena Park
Director of Engineering
HealthSync
attachments: healthsync_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf, 210KB); healthsync_logo_pack.zip (zip, 2.4MB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: feature HealthSync migration vignette in 'Engineering Spotlight'

Thanks Elena — this is great and the metric change makes sense.

Marissa / Vanessa — can we lock this down quickly? Two asks: 
- Marissa, please update the draft with Elena’s quote tweak and prepare the short permission form (one page) for signature. I prefer DocuSign for traceability; include a clause around logo usage and the exact channels (site, blog, sales collateral).
- Vanessa, once Marissa shares the final copy + permission form, can you run a quick comms/legal checklist? If everything’s standard, please approve so we can route to Elena for signature.

Elena — thanks again. We’ll send the updated doc and a DocuSign envelope by EOD today.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
